item.title: How to Separate Events from Kubernetes to a Dedicated Etcd
item.description: The disk pressure on the original etcd is reduced to below 5%, the risk factor is very low, and the cluster shows no anomalies. 1. Deploying the Events Etcd Cluster Events have lower consistency requirements than the main Etcd. Deploying a 3-node cluster is recommended. SSD is recommended for the disk, and the data directory should be kept separate from the main Etcd.
